title: Editor Backend Core Live Compatibility Harness
summary: Add an accepted live compatibility harness that starts the Backend HTTP server, consumes it through the Editor backend client, migrates a Core-backed document, commits a mutation, and applies the resulting envelopes into Editor runtime state.
expectedOutput: An Editor-owned live integration test or a boundary blocker that distinguishes real Editor client to Backend server to Core semantic compatibility from mocked transport evidence, followed by Project Control evidence registration without broad map promotion.
riskSummary: The prior compatibility review found no accepted single live harness; this lane must avoid direct Editor imports of Core internals, Backend semantic duplication, and Project Control truth promotion before repository-owned gates pass.
